title: Nothing outside the loop driver depends on it, and every hook looper will call is a `bun nv` command

stages.title: the shared code leaves the driver
stages.summary: Moves the check model, the runner, the Linux legs, the origin, the sweep lock, `sweepOver` and `sweepIds` to `tools/nv/accept/` and the process tree to `tools/nv/lib/`, so nothing outside the driver and the seven loop commands imports them.

playbook: Tooling > a wrap `## commit:` that names*
Tooling > a `## commit:` section cannot name
Tooling > a file deleted with `git rm`*

stages.title: the check runners
stages.summary: Adds `bun nv suite`, `bun nv legs` and `bun nv services`, and the driver calls their code.

stages.title: the session hooks
stages.summary: Adds `bun nv sweep`, `bun nv benches`, `bun nv side --prepare` and `bun nv allow --learn`, and the driver calls their code.

stages.title: the wrap sections, the pack sections and the written paths
stages.summary: Adds `bun nv plan --apply` and `bun nv pack`, which `nv session --wrap` and `nv orient` call, and `lib/written.ts` also writes `LOOPER_WRITTEN`.

stages.title: the runbook names the commands
stages.summary: Brings `docs/agent/looper-cutover.md` and `docs/agent/commands.md` up to the commands as built, and a test holds the runbook's hook table to `bun nv help`.

checks.name: nothing outside the driver and the seven loop commands imports them, and the shared modules live outside the driver
argv: nothing outside the driver and the loop commands imports them|the shared modules live outside the driver

checks.name: `bun nv suite` judges a suite of cases with its named-case and minimum conditions
argv: nv suite passes when every named case ran and none failed|nv suite fails on a named case that is not on disk|nv suite fails on a named case that was skipped|nv suite fails when fewer cases pass than --min-passing

checks.name: `bun nv legs` reads the goal's env and exits by the legs' verdict
argv: nv legs reads the WSL target and the valgrind skip list from the goal's env|nv legs exits 1 on a red leg and 0 on a green one

checks.name: `bun nv services --up` brings up the goal's docker services, or does nothing without them
argv: nv services --up brings up the compose services the goal's env names|nv services --up does nothing and exits 0 for a goal with no docker env|nv services --up exits 1 when the docker daemon cannot be reached

checks.name: the driver calls the check runners' code, and none of it is defined twice
argv: the check runners have one home

checks.name: `bun nv sweep` writes `.loop/last-sweep.md`, keeps the floor gate's cadence and always exits 0
argv: nv sweep writes each red check to .loop/last-sweep.md|nv sweep removes .loop/last-sweep.md when the sweep is green|nv sweep exits 0 when a check is red or the sweep cannot run|nv sweep opens the floor gate on every tenth sweep and holds the heavy checks otherwise

checks.name: `bun nv side --prepare` makes a side worktree and is safe to repeat
argv: nv side --prepare makes the worktree and its branch when they are missing|nv side --prepare run twice changes nothing the second time

checks.name: `bun nv allow --learn` records a finished session and settles the owed rules
argv: nv allow --learn records the tool calls of a finished session|nv allow --learn adds the owed rules to the settings file

checks.name: `bun nv benches [--owed]` is the bench turn by hand, and the guard holds it to the loop's cadence
argv: nv benches takes --owed and no other flag|the guard refuses nv benches as a heavy run

checks.name: the driver calls the session hooks' code, none of it is defined twice, and `nv loop --benches` is gone
argv: the session hooks have one home

checks.name: `bun nv plan --apply` checks and writes the wrap's plan, plan-edit and milestone sections
argv: nv plan --apply --dry checks the plan sections and writes nothing|nv plan --apply writes a plan field, a plan edit and a milestone|nv plan --apply refuses a plan field that grows past its ceiling

checks.name: `bun nv pack` prints the Novis-only pack sections for a goal and a stage
argv: nv pack prints the rules, shapes, plan fields and milestones of the goal and its stage|nv pack takes the goal and the stage from LOOPER_GOAL and LOOPER_STAGE when no flag names them|nv pack prints no section for a goal whose context is empty

checks.name: `lib/written.ts` appends to the file `NOVIS_LOOP_WRITES` names and the one `LOOPER_WRITTEN` names
argv: record appends to the files NOVIS_LOOP_WRITES and LOOPER_WRITTEN name|record writes nothing when neither variable is set

checks.name: `nv session --wrap` and `nv orient` call the moved section code, and none of it is defined twice
argv: the wrap and orient sections have one home

checks.name: every `bun nv` command the cutover runbook's hook table names is registered in `main.ts`
argv: every command the cutover runbook names is registered
